subject: ParcelAI renewal health: adoption thresholds and capacity pathway

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: ParcelAI Procurement <procurement@parcelai.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: ParcelAI renewal health: adoption thresholds and capacity pathway

Hi Elena / procurement team,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. I pulled a short usage snapshot and a high-level ROI recap for the last 6 months to help frame the renewal conversation. Key context up front: your core routing workflow accounts for ~72% of token consumption, and a sudden shift in request concurrency last month drove our average latency up ~18ms for peak windows.

Attachments: parcelai_q2_perf_report.pdf (summary + charts) and a one-page mutual_action_plan_parcelai.xlsx (proposed cadence / decision checkpoints).

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min review of the numbers and the impact of the concurrency spike (I can run smoothing options)
- Walk through two capacity pathways: conservative (rightsize + small burst cushion) vs. growth (2x baseline commit with a 10% discount band)
- Align procurement requirements (SLAs, audit logs, egress terms) and dates for signature

Are you available Wed 4th or Thu 5th for a 30-min call? I’ll include Ben (renewals) and Grace (solutions) on the follow-up so we can cover pricing and technical mitigation.

Cheers,
Soojin

1) Can you break the ROI by feature? Specifically: routing workflow vs. enrichment calls vs. analytics batch jobs.
2) For the concurrency spike, do you have a short remediation plan we can present to engineering (ideal timeline + expected token delta)?

Ben / Grace — forwarding ParcelAI’s reply and the attachments they confirmed. Meeting Thu 5th 11:00 PT (Elena + procurement). Ask and context below:

Context / notes:
- Current committed baseline: 18M tokens/month, net effective run-rate 14.2M tokens (they underutilize burst credits).
- Last month surge pushed peak concurrency and increased tail latency; engineering signal suggests short-term fixes can lower token amplification from retries by ~7-9%.
- Their adoption mix: 72% routing, 18% enrichment, 10% analytics (estimated from Q2).

Requests I expect from ParcelAI:
- A pricing pathway that preserves unit economics if they grow 1.5–2x over the next 6 months
- Clear SLA language for latency targets during peak windows and audit log export cadence
- A modest commercial concession (they’ve mentioned packaging constraints) — something in the 7–12% discount range or burst credit top-up to smooth the first 2 months post-signing.

Attached: parcelai_q2_perf_report.pdf (detailed charts), mutual_action_plan_parcelai.xlsx (draft timeline).

Can you: 1) flag acceptable concession ranges (Ben), and 2) confirm technical mitigation sequence we can present to Elena that realistically reduces token duplication and latency (Grace)?

Thanks — I want us aligned on slides and the MAP before the call. I’ll draft the customer-facing one-pager once we confirm numbers.

— Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 31 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ParcelAI renewal health: adoption thresholds and capacity pathway

+1 on the approach. For concessions: our standard playground — for mid-market renewals with strong adoption signals we can offer up to 10% on annualized committed spend or 60 days of burst credits (non-recurring) as an alternative. Anything above 10% needs CRO approval.

Grace — if you can quantify expected token delta from the engineering mitigations (slide: pre/post expected tokens, latency improvement) by EOD Fri I’ll draft two commercial scenarios (Conservative: rightsize + 30% burst + 5% discount; Growth: 2x commit + 10% discount + SLA addendum).

I’ll also propose a 30-day technical onboarding credit to accelerate commit if they sign within 30 days.

Ben
